key_terms.إِبْلِيسَ: Iblis, Satan, the source of misguidance and temptation

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith mean by saying that poetry is from Iblis?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a severe condemnation of poetry by attributing it to Iblis. It serves as a brief ethical warning and reflects a caution toward forms of speech associated with falsehood, temptation, or misguidance.
